slides: Let's continue with percentages, and learn the fractions to know by heart.

slides.say: Some fractions come up again and again on the exam. It's worth knowing their percents by heart, because then we don't need to calculate.
A half is fifty percent. A quarter is twenty-five percent. Almost everyone knows these two.
What people forget is an eighth. An eighth is twelve and a half percent.
How do we remember it? A quarter is half of a half, and twenty-five is half of fifty. An eighth is half of a quarter. So we halve twenty-five too, and half of twenty-five is twelve and a half.
at: An eighth is half of a quarter

slides.say: On the exam you'll see twelve point five, and also twelve and a half. It's the same number, so get used to both.
As decimals it's the same idea. Zero point five, zero point two five, and zero point one two five.
Now a second family. A tenth is ten percent. Most of us know this one for sure.
A fifth is two tenths. So it's twice ten percent, twenty percent.
And a twentieth is half of a tenth. Half of ten percent is five percent.
Let's check it with the rule from before. One over twenty. Twenty times five is a hundred, so the top is one times five, five. Five over a hundred is five percent. It fits.
at: Five over a hundred is five

slides.say: A third is thirty-three and a third percent. Sometimes you'll see it as thirty-three point three three, and so on.
A sixth is less known. A sixth is half of a third. So we halve thirty-three and a third.
at: A sixth is half of a third

slides.say: That's not easy to halve in your head. Here's a quick way. Half of thirty-two is sixteen. So a sixth is sixteen and a bit.
Exactly, it's sixteen and two thirds percent. Half of thirty-three is sixteen and a half. Half of a third is a sixth. And sixteen and a half plus a sixth is sixteen and two thirds.
at: And sixteen and a half plus a sixth

slides.say: On the exam, sixteen and a bit is usually enough, because only one choice will be close to it.
Now let's build the families. Once we know the basic fraction, we can build the rest by multiplying.
An eighth is twelve and a half percent. So three eighths is three times twelve and a half.
at: So three eighths is three times

slides.say: Three times twelve is thirty-six. And three halves are one and a half. So it's thirty-seven and a half percent.
Five eighths is five times twelve and a half. Five times twelve is sixty, and five halves are two and a half. So it's sixty-two and a half percent.
A fifth is twenty percent. So three fifths is three times twenty, sixty percent. And four fifths is eighty percent.
A twentieth is five percent. So seven twentieths is seven times five, thirty-five percent.

slides: So don't try to memorize every fraction. Know the basic ones, and then multiply. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next part.
